title: Tiny, cute pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x="40" y="20" width="20" height="50" rx="2" fill="#F4C542"/>
  <!-- lighter stripe on body -->
  <rect x="40" y="20" width="6" height="50" rx="2" fill="#FCE27A"/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x="40" y="12" width="20" height="10" rx="3" fill="#F28BA8"/>
  <!-- lighter eraser highlight -->
  <rect x="40" y="12" width="5" height="10" rx="3" fill="#FAB8CB"/>
  <!-- metal ferrule -->
  <rect x="40" y="20" width="20" height="6" fill="#A8C8DC"/>
  <!-- lighter ferrule highlight -->
  <rect x="40" y="20" width="5" height="6" fill="#D4E8F4"/>
  <!-- wood tip -->
  <polygon points="40,70 60,70 50,88" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <!-- lighter wood highlight -->
  <polygon points="40,70 47,70 50,84" fill="#F5D6A8"/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points="46,82 54,82 50,92" fill="#6E5A8E"/>
  <!-- graphite highlight -->
  <polygon points="47,83 50,83 50,88" fill="#9A86B8"/>
  <!-- cute face on pencil body -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="40" r="2.5" fill="#3D2B5E"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="40" r="2.5" fill="#3D2B5E"/>
  <path d="M46 46 Q50 50 54 46" stroke="#3D2B5E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="45" r="2" fill="#F28BA8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="2" fill="#F28BA8" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
